# comments.create — POST /posts/{id}/comments

Comment on a post

Adds a comment to any post, drafts included. Pass `parentId` to reply to another comment of the same post.

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.comments.create({ path: { id: "0" }, body: { text: "Nice post!" } })
res.assert(201)
```

## Input
```ts
{ path: {
  /** Post id. */
  "id": string
}; body: CreateCommentDto }
```

## Responses
```ts
201: CommentDto // The created comment. `replies` is empty.
400: ErrorDto // Empty text or non-integer `parentId`.
401: ErrorDto // Missing or invalid bearer token.
404: ErrorDto // No post with this id, or `parentId` is not a comment of this post.
```

## Types
```ts
type CreateCommentDto = {
  /** Comment text, non-empty. */
  "text": string
  /** Id of the comment to reply to. It must belong to the same post. Omit for a top-level comment. */
  "parentId"?: number
}
type CommentDto = {
  /** Comment id. */
  "id": number
  /** Comment text. */
  "text": string
  /** Id of the user who wrote the comment. */
  "authorId": number
  /** Replies to this comment, oldest first. */
  "replies": Array<CommentDto>
}
type ErrorDto = {
  /** HTTP status code. */
  "statusCode": number
  /** Error message. Validation errors (400) return a list: one message per failed constraint. */
  "message": string | Array<string>
  /** HTTP status text, e.g. "Not Found". */
  "error"?: string
}
```
